notes.title: Update Notes v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are doing well. Meanings hidden in plain sight is out for a little over a month now, so you had some time to find the solutions for the 100 images at release. With today's update, new images are added to challenge you once again. Have fun solving!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] 50 new images! Each new image has 10 different solutions.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] In singleplayer, the points collected are shown again instead of cryptic characters.
[/list]
Should you encounter any issues during play please reach out to me and let me know. You can do so either via a comment here or by joining my Discord server. I'll keep an eye and try to provide fixes for reported issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are doing well. Just a small update today to change how leaderboards are stored. Expect a bigger update soon, maybe on the weekend already? But now, let's dive into the change.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards are now stored in one file. Previously, every time you changed the points distribution, a new file was created for that distribution. Going forward, only one file is used and every time a game ends a new entry is added to the file. Modifying the points distribution no longer creates a new entry. Old leaderboards will be converted to the new structure on startup.
[/list]
Should you encounter any issues during play please reach out to me and let me know. You can do so either via a comment here or by joining my Discord server. I'll keep an eye and try to provide fixes for reported issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are doing well. Time for another update changelog.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now find a quick settings panel in the game view. This panel allows you to quickly change settings like the round timer, if audio is playing and how loud it is or if the hover zoom is active. The panel can be toggled by clicking the gear icon in the bottom left corner of the game view.
[*] You can now zoom in on images by hovering over them. This feature can be toggled in the settings and the quick settings panel.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Usernames are no longer hardcoded in length. The initial implementation had a hardcoded maximum length. This was replaced by a more dynamic approach, allowing longer usernames to be shown with more letters visible before being truncated with three dots. As the game progresses and players accumulate more points, the username gets shortened if necessary.
[*] You can now find the changelog of every update within the game. Whenever an update is released, it will pop up automatically. If you want to check it out again afterwards just click on the version number in the top left corner.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game no longer plays the meaning solved audio when loading a round with partially solved meanings.
[/list]
Should you encounter any issues during play please reach out to me and let me know. You can do so either via a comment here or by joining my Discord server. I'll keep an eye and try to provide fixes for reported issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I hope you are doing well. Following the release and bugfix update 1.0.1 I've took a short break, energized myself again and now I'm back with more improvements, some fixes and even an easter egg. Let's jump right in.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved layout when using Windows scale in display setttings. The game now supports 125%, 150%, 175%, 200% and 225% scaling besides the default 100%. Any lower/higher scaling values as well as custom scaling values are not supported. On some scaling values not all resolutions are available in the settings due to them not offering enough space for the interface. I've tried my best to not make interface elements smaller to fit in a higher scaling as this would negate the whole effect of scaling in the first place.
[*] Added explanation to the round timer input explaining that the timer is reset when a meaning is solved.
[*] The current version of the game is now shown in the top right corner. This change was implemented to make debugging of future issues easier for me by immediately being able to check if the player is using the latest version. Should you report a bug please include the version number, thank you.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Translations for correct guesses and guesses taken in singleplayer mode are now pluralized.
[/list]

Should you encounter any issues during play please reach out to me and let me know. You can do so either via a comment here or by joining my Discord server. I'll keep an eye and try to provide fixes for reported issues as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

yesterdays release was quite successful in my eyes. No major issues were reported and I was lucky enough to be part in a stream where the streamer enjoyed the game together with her community.

I noticed a few minor issues during that stream for which improvements and fixes are included in this update.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changes to the timer input field now waits for you to click outside of the input field. This change allows you to clear the input field before entering a new number instead of resetting to the last value immediately upon clearing.
[*] One image had the word "mirror" associated even though there is no mirror in the image. I replaced it with a more appropriate word.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replaced the German word "Entspannung" associated with an image with something else as it has 11 letters and the word length is limited to 10 characters.
[*] Setting a resolution in windowed mode now results in the game area to fill the selected resolution. Previously, due to a small mistake, the actual area was smaller. [i]Note[/i]: The whole window (including the title bar) will be a bit bigger than the selected resolution. This is expected as the chosen resolution reflects the frame of the game, not the size of the window including borders and the title bar.
[*] The leaderboard table now fills the whole available area.
[/list]

Should you encounter any issues during play please reach out to me and let me know. You can do so either via a comment here or by joining my Discord server. I'll keep an eye and try to provide fixes for reported issues as soon as possible.
